reviews.text: Very antisocial drivers! I wouldn't entrust my dog ​​to such drivers. Pathetic behavior, putting a bit of pressure on learner drivers.

We're so happy with Viervoeten! The communication is incredibly good; they send photos and videos of the walks, and they're very flexible, both for the morning/afternoon walks and the daycare at Viervoetenland. From the very first moment, I had a good feeling with Pepe and the team, and I still feel that way. Thank you so much for looking after our Fred!

My German Shepherd has been staying with Viervoeten weekly for a year and a half and recently started staying in hotels for several days. I always have peace of mind knowing she's in good hands. The team is professional, appointments are kept on time, and communication is excellent. Thanks to the Viervoeten team!

Viervoeten is a fantastic and professional dog walking and daycare service! Our dog has been joining both the walking service and daycare at Vieroetenland since she was a puppy. Major plus points: dogs spend only a short time in the van (good logistics for pick-up), are transported in crates, pick-up and drop-off are always on time and in short, clear time slots, and our dog gets plenty of exercise every day at Viervoetenland. I am extremely satisfied, so I highly recommend it! The contact with owner Pepe and the other staff members is also always pleasant. Highly recommended.

We are super satisfied with Viervoeten! Professional, super friendly walkers, quick communication, and they always think along with you and proactively look for solutions to your question. Flexible regarding days on or off, and nowadays they also offer daycare! We are huge fans, and so is our dog :-)

Viervoeten is a really great dog walking service. My dog ​​went along for quite a while because I couldn't walk due to an accident. She loved it. The people who work there are nice and really love dogs. And they are very reliable and considerate.

The professional and warm team at Viervoeten is fantastic. Louie went walking with them several days a week for about three years and always came home more than satisfied and completely content. Louie was in the best hands we could have wished for. There's no better feeling than knowing your furry friend is having fun in nature with other dogs and kind, trustworthy people. Unfortunately, due to our move outside of Amsterdam, Lou couldn't join us anymore—we miss them terribly!

[Photo: Louie walking with Viervoeten.]

Sjaakie has been going with Viervoeten every week for over a year now. We are very enthusiastic about this dog walking service. Every week, Sjaakie joins along full of enthusiasm and comes home nice and tired. He thinks the walks with …
Nice people. Nox is always very happy to go for a walk with you!
